easyPrerequisites:
An opponent controls a nonland permanent with an equal or lesser mana value than the one you wish to donate.
Lure attached to Sentinel.
Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Puca's Mischief triggers, exchanging control of a nonland permanent an opponent controls with equal or lesser mana value and Surrak.
During your next declare attackers step, declare Sentinel as an attacker, forcing Surrak to block it due to Lure.
Holding priority, activate Sentinel an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Surrak.
Surrak triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
